svg.title: Smart Semester database schema reference
svg.desc: All six tables defined by the current database migrations, with columns, types, key constraints, indexes, enforced foreign keys, and logical course-code matches distinguished.
svg.text: Migration-defined schema • all tables, columns, key constraints, and query-relevant indexes

g.text: Logical code match only (not an FK)
PK = primary key • FK = foreign key • UQ = unique • NN = NOT NULL • IDX = index

svg.text: courses: uq_courses_code_year; idx_courses_code_year; GIN indexes on prereq_tree and coreq_tree.
syllabi: UNIQUE(source_url); indexes on course_code, semester_code, and (course_code, semester_code).
syllabus_documents: UNIQUE(syllabus_id); indexes on syllabus_id, content_hash, source_url, and partial manual_review_required.
syllabus_observations: indexes on course_code, syllabus_id, document_id, category, and GIN(provenance).
Matching course_code values do not create an FK: syllabi, observations, and summaries can be joined by code by convention.
• Solid arrows point from a referencing FK
at most one document row per syllabus.
clause; document and observation FKs do.
Reference snapshot of the migration-defined schema (not introspected from a running database). Check/apply migrations if a local database differs.
